name: runtime-priority-counterbalanced

prompts: Explain in ten short numbered sentences how virtual memory works in a modern operating system.
Explain in exactly twenty numbered sentences why sequential memory access is usually faster than random memory access. Keep each sentence concise.
Explain in exactly twenty numbered sentences how CPU caches reduce average memory-access latency. Keep each sentence concise.
Explain in exactly twenty numbered sentences why contiguous arrays often have good cache locality. Keep each sentence concise.

description: Counterbalanced confirmation experiment for Windows Normal versus High process priority. L4 is disabled in every condition; each measured prompt runs in a fresh isolated LOCAL-only state.
